name: Ghibli II
description: The Maserati Ghibli II (1992–1998), developed under Fiat ownership, revived the legendary Ghibli name with a modern twin-turbocharged 2.8-litre V6. A sharp, Marcello Gandini–styled coupe, it marked Maserati's gradual recovery after the troubled Citroën and De Tomaso eras.
